content: When optimizing multi-channel network acceleration for a phone paired with a host proxy service, always first confirm the phone's traffic path (direct, host-proxied, or hybrid) via the host mihomo API (http://127.0.0.1:9091/connections) by checking for connections from the phone's local IP (192.168.123.22) or NetBird IP (100.87.x.x) before modifying host-side mihomo configurations, as host config changes are ineffective if phone traffic does not route through the host proxy.
